title: A dependent customer's link opens its page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with no work orders, part sales, assets or contacts of its own.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's Edit Customer window.
  2. Click Delete.
  3. Click Delete in the Confirmation window.
  4. Click customer A's name in the window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer B's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • A "Confirmation" window asks "Are you sure you want to delete this company?" with "Cancel" and "Delete".

Step 3:

  • A "Delete Customer" window opens: "This customer is the default Bill To for [customer A's name]. Remove it from that customer first."

Step 4:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
